question: Same original I opportunity and one independent initial cash balance: E0/I hold versus F sell, wait and legally repurchase the SAME stock. No cross-stock reinvestment.
common: All experiment-one 5349 E0 epochs and 407 stocks; Dec29 2023 decisions through Oct27 2026 terminal. Equal events, stock-equal sensitivity, all no-fill/open/rights retained.
initial: Read-only I units/audits. Exact same actual first decision/fill/quantity/gross/fees per cost. Earlier zero-fill I attempts have no economic charges. After that no external funding.
F: Original INTENT-SUPPORT F: half sqrt5 reversal threshold, unchanged 63/21 share-volume participation clipped .5..2. At each close check old protection first. If not broken, max old protection/original i_floor/new F up-pivot, whose pivot_date >= actual buy date. New protection effective next observation.
reentry: After fully sold, next original full-Q I event observed after actual sale may reserve only own available cash. Same-day close after open sale allowed. Next eligible open/day-expiry, original gap support rejection. F alone never buys. Unlimited natural retries until frozen E0/source boundary.
reset: Each actual repurchase resets protection to i_floor frozen on its decision; old holding F line discarded, market F observer never reset. No carry to another E0 epoch. Pending exit persists until executable.
cash: Native A-sale settlement lag0 cash and buy-lot sellability lag1 are distinct. No invented day idle; no proceeds borrowing or principal resets. Whole-share quantities, minimum order/fees and capacity inherited.
terminal: All actual incurred fees and terminal raw marks/claims included. Estimated liquidation separately, not a fill. Frozen E0/source end forbids new buys; legal exit may settle later.
primary: Delta=sum(P_F-P_I), P=terminal NAV-1m; tail partition fixed to each cost original I net_return>=.30, realized/terminal separately. Tail retention plus ordinary Delta, continuous/top-I contributions. Win rate descriptive.
accounting: Daily close Delta increments in initial_hold, idle, repurchased_hold, pending_exit or mixed_trade_action. Sum equals terminal Delta. Fees and raw-open slippage are memo only, never deducted twice. Idle/reentry attribution is accounting not causal.
verdict: Positive total with nonnegative ordinary and tail is sufficient, not necessary. Mixed signs report tradeoff; negative total cannot pass on lower drawdown. Cost/weight reversal or limited cases inconclusive. No after-outcome rule change.
correctness: Exact initial control receipt; independent Decimal shares/fees/cash/NAV; daily I reconstruction equals existing terminal; daily Delta decomposition; no external cash; causal protection/entry/exit; prefix samples; sample/full consistency.
budget: Sample first, then full F computation <=300 seconds; input identity/development separate. No whole portfolio or scans.
boundaries: Removed original ACT, ranking, six-slot/industry competition and 15% account budget only as authorized mechanism diagnostic.
Common independent E0 epoch ends and first I actual participation inherited from experiment one; not original whole-account strategy reproduction.
Original F code initializes its private fast_floor on first held close; this diagnostic explicitly starts original frozen entry support and applies original I guard, then F max; separately audited.
Original F entry-date inference scans fills after last sale date; diagnostic tracks actual fully-flat cycles to support partial fills without mislabelling a partial sale as a new holding.
Original I full Q retained including stock/sector readiness, sector E0/current availability, G1 and frozen snapshot identities; no ACT/cash/rank competition.
